description: This file contains unit tests for the Azure Table Storage-based reminder service within the Orleans project. It includes test classes, fixture setup, and numerous test methods verifying various scenarios such as basic operations, failover, multi-grain/reminder handling, silo management, and error conditions.

classes.name: ReminderTests_AzureTable
classes.description: Unit test class for Azure Table reminder service, containing multiple test methods for verifying functionality, failover, and concurrency scenarios.

classes.description: Fixture class for setting up the Orleans test cluster with Azure Table reminder service configuration.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures individual silos to use Azure Table Reminder Service with default test options.
